blockedReasons.role-refused: The account that asked for it may no longer run it.
blockedReasons.scope-refused: The account that asked for it may no longer reach what it works on.
blockedReasons.target-out-of-scope: What it works on is outside the account's group.
blockedReasons.group-out-of-scope: Its group is outside the account's group.
blockedReasons.principal-missing: The account that asked for it is gone.
blockedReasons.plugin-unavailable: Its plugin is disabled or not loaded.
blockedReasons.plugins-unavailable: Plugins are not available on this server.
blockedReasons.plugin-action-unavailable: Its plugin no longer offers this action.
blockedReasons.action-unavailable: Its plugin no longer offers this action.
blockedReasons.registration-changed: Its plugin changed what this action allows since it was asked for.
blockedReasons.closure-callback-gone: The plugin code it was to run is gone.
blockedReasons.input-unavailable: Its saved input can no longer be read.
blockedReasons.adapter-missing: This server cannot run this kind of job.
blockedReasons.reconciliation-refused: Its outcome after a restart could not be settled.
